notes: LoRA stacks are now capped by priority instead of failing. fal rejects any request with more than 3 LoRAs outright (the whole photo bounced to fallback), and FLUX output goes mushy past ~4 anyway. When more LoRAs match a photo than the engine allows, the app now keeps the most important ones — the character's own likeness LoRAs first, then the director's contextual picks, then keyword matches, then always-on styles — and logs exactly which were dropped ('lora cap 3 — dropped: …'). Trigger words of dropped LoRAs no longer ride the prompt either.
